# ABTune

> ABTune is a free music taste quiz that builds a playlist. You answer quick this-or-that cards (Bon Jovi or Britney? 80s or 90s? Road trip or study session?) and get one of 16 music personalities, a sound profile, and a playlist of songs people know, picked from an open catalog of about 2 million songs. No login, no ads, and no Spotify account needed.

- It runs in the browser at __ABTUNE_URL__ and takes about two minutes (10, 20, 50 or 100 cards). Playlists are 25, 50 or 100 songs.
- The result: one of 16 music personalities (such as Sunburst Revivalist or Night-Drive Ghost), a sound profile on nine scales (energy, mood, danceability and six more), top genres and eras.
- The playlist can be tweaked (more energy, moodier, newer…), reshuffled and extended, added to Spotify, Apple Music or YouTube Music, exported as M3U, CSV, XSPF or JSON, or shared as a link that rebuilds it on any device.
- It doesn't use Spotify's data. Spotify closed its recommendations and audio-features API to new apps in November 2024; ABTune's catalog is built from MusicBrainz, ListenBrainz and AcousticBrainz data (MetaBrainz Foundation).
- How songs are picked: each answer moves a profile of 9 sound scales, 24 genre clusters, 8 decades and 5 languages. The server scores the catalog against it, favors well-known songs, allows at most two songs per artist, and orders the list along an energy curve. The same answers always give the same playlist.
- Privacy: answers stay in the browser. The server gets only the taste profile (a few dozen numbers) and keeps no record of it. No accounts, cookies or tracking IDs.
- Open source: code under MIT, catalog data under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 US. Made by David (github.com/mrdushidush), built with Claude Code.

## Pages

- [The quiz](__ABTUNE_URL__): the app, with how it works and common questions.
- [The 16 music personalities](__ABTUNE_URL__types): the four traits behind them (energy, mood, era, texture) and how each is worked out.
- [Privacy](__ABTUNE_URL__privacy): what the site and its social accounts collect, and for how long.
- [Terms](__ABTUNE_URL__terms): the terms of use.

## Music personalities

Each page says what the type's four traits mean together and names five well-known songs that ABTune's catalog itself places there.

- [Sunburst Revivalist](__ABTUNE_URL__types/sunburst-revivalist): Big, sunny songs played by real bands, mostly from before 2000.
- [Neon Nostalgist](__ABTUNE_URL__types/neon-nostalgist): Upbeat, plugged-in songs with synths and a big studio sound, mostly from before 2000.
- [Festival Wanderer](__ABTUNE_URL__types/festival-wanderer): Feel-good songs with real instruments, with plenty from 2000 on.
- [Dancefloor Futurist](__ABTUNE_URL__types/dancefloor-futurist): Upbeat, synth-driven songs made for moving, with plenty from 2000 on.
- [Thunder Purist](__ABTUNE_URL__types/thunder-purist): Driving, brooding songs played by real bands, mostly from before 2000.
- [Midnight Synth Rider](__ABTUNE_URL__types/midnight-synth-rider): Driving, shadowy songs with synths and beats, mostly from before 2000.
- [Riff Rebel](__ABTUNE_URL__types/riff-rebel): Loud, moody guitar songs, with plenty from 2000 on.
- [Bass-Drop Outlaw](__ABTUNE_URL__types/bass-drop-outlaw): Hard-hitting electronic and hip-hop songs with a dark edge, with plenty from 2000 on.
- [Porch Poet](__ABTUNE_URL__types/porch-poet): Easygoing, warm songs with guitar and piano, mostly from before 2000.
- [Lounge Lizard](__ABTUNE_URL__types/lounge-lizard): Smooth, groovy songs with electric keys and basslines, mostly from before 2000.
- [Coffeehouse Romantic](__ABTUNE_URL__types/coffeehouse-romantic): Gentle, warm songs with acoustic instruments, with plenty from 2000 on.
- [Lo-fi Sunbather](__ABTUNE_URL__types/lo-fi-sunbather): Relaxed, sunny electronic songs, with plenty from 2000 on.
- [Rainy-Day Balladeer](__ABTUNE_URL__types/rainy-day-balladeer): Slow, sad songs with guitar and piano, mostly from before 2000.
- [Smoky Noir Detective](__ABTUNE_URL__types/smoky-noir-detective): Slow, shadowy songs with beats and atmosphere, mostly from before 2000.
- [Candlelit Confessor](__ABTUNE_URL__types/candlelit-confessor): Quiet, heartfelt songs with acoustic instruments, with plenty from 2000 on.
- [Night-Drive Ghost](__ABTUNE_URL__types/night-drive-ghost): Slow, moody electronic songs for late nights, with plenty from 2000 on.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mrdushidush/abtune): the code, the catalog pipeline, and self-hosting with Docker.
- [Design brief](https://github.com/mrdushidush/abtune/blob/main/docs/HANDOFF.md): how the quiz, the taste model and playlist generation work.
- [Decision log](https://github.com/mrdushidush/abtune/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md): every design choice since, with its reason.

## Optional

- [MCP server](https://github.com/mrdushidush/abtune#use-it-from-claude-code-mcp): lets Claude Code or another MCP host take the quiz from a plain description and return a playlist (self-hosted, with an installed catalog).
